_readme: Committed settings (no secrets). The API key is read from the env var named in api_key_env.
_entities_readme: Entity name -> row count the API docs advertise. Used only to warn on mismatch.

weather._readme: Environment Canada historical climate data (no key). TORONTO INTL A is ~10 km from both yards.

model._readme: Fixed UTC offset for telematics timestamps. All modelled dates are EST (no DST).

night._readme: Night low = coldest hour from start_hour the evening before the callout morning to end_hour that morning.

rules._readme: Thresholds sit between the closest failure and the closest non-failure in history (see data/derived/evidence.json).
